audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows were inverted against this page's own prose: Level 1 read Heimerdinger while whys[0] and spikes[0] call it your one clean window before any turret is down; Levels 3 and 4-5 and both item rows read Renekton while whys[2], whys[3], whys[5] and whys[6] describe the nest closing your all-in and his AP scaling taking the lane.
audit.why: Packet chart is Renekton, Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, and the mirror (heimerdinger__renekton) set rows 0, 2, 3, 5 and 6 to exactly that in both layers.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 5, 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs; ratings re-spread 6/6/4/4/3/3/3 with Level 6 left at 3/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: The First-item row credited your Eclipse, but spikes[2] and spikes[3] on this page say the decisive item window is his nest plus his first AP item, with Stridebreaker only usable once the grenade is spent.
audit.why: Turret damage and UPGRADE!!! rockets scale with his AP; your curve is front-loaded and needs the level 1-3 window.
audit.corrected: phases[2].why, phases[3].why, phases[5].why and phases[6].why rewritten to the real order, with the grenade cooldown as the trigger.

audit.whatIsWrong: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade was described only as 'his self-peel stun, dodge it'. Riot's text is more useful: it stuns only what it directly hits and merely slows everything around the impact, and it sits at a flat 11s at every rank — so the punish window never shortens as he levels it. Hextech Micro-Rockets' 1325 range, which is why a poke war is unwinnable, was never given.
audit.why: Heimerdinger E: 'stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units', cd 11 at all ranks, range 970. W: range 1325, 'rockets that converge on his cursor'.
audit.corrected: The direct-hit condition and flat 11s stated in dosFull[0].d and report[5].t; the rocket range in dontsFull[2].d; the combo interrupt in dontsFull[1].d.

edits.before: Fury autos bully the first waves. Identify how Heimerdinger contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Fury autos bully wave one — no turret is down yet, so harass him off the wave and deny the H-28G placement.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Heimerdinger must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: His nest is forming and CH-2 interrupts your combo — the all-in now costs you the grenade first, and he plays around that.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around CH-2 Grenade's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Two turrets on the wave tax every E entry — your only safe all-in is the few seconds right after CH-2 is spent, so count its 11s.

edits.before: Eclipse is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on CH-2 Grenade's cooldown.
edits.after: His first AP item plus a full nest beats your Eclipse — fight only on a spent grenade.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Heimerdinger carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: AP scaling turns his turrets and UPGRADE!!! rockets into a furnace your melee body cannot enter — take objectives, not the 1v1.

edits.before: His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Only a direct hit stuns — the splash just slows. 11s flat, every rank.

edits.before: Track Heimerdinger's CH-2 Grenade (Stun): His self-peel stun. Dodge it. When it is down — W-stun + Q him.
edits.after: CH-2 stuns only on a direct hit and is 11s at every rank — eat the edge slow, then E in and stun him.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: It interrupts your empowered W and hands his turrets free autos.

edits.before: Trading at zero fury or overstaying after the burst — the second dash OUT is the half of the combo people forget.
edits.after: Hextech Micro-Rockets reach 1325 and converge on his cursor — you will never win a range war, so close or leave.

notes: The packet itself flags a contradiction I did not resolve: Renekton wins 53.75% over 560 games, yet the chart (packet, mirror and now this page) gives Heimerdinger five of seven stages. The chart is at least internally consistent with the prose on both pages after this edit, but diff still reads TRICKY at 7.5/10 on a lane you win by four points of win rate — and the mirror moved its own side to FAV 4.5/10, which points the same way. That needs a human call, so I left diff, diffRating and the final-rating line untouched rather than guess.
